description: Logo design, corporate identity and brand guidelines for businesses in Arta and Epirus. Since 2013 we have designed identities that work equally well on a shop sign, a business card and a screen.
services_description: From the logo through to the complete identity system for your business.

services.title: Logo Design
services.description: An original logo designed from scratch, in vector format, with variants for every use — from favicon to shop sign.

services.title: Corporate Identity
services.description: Business cards, letterheads, envelopes, stamps, email signatures and whatever else your business needs to look consistent everywhere.

services.title: Brand Strategy
services.description: Positioning, target audience, tone of voice and core messaging. The foundation the visual design is built on.

services.title: Brand Guidelines
services.description: A usage manual covering colours, typography, spacing and examples of correct and incorrect use, so the identity stays consistent no matter who applies it.

services.title: Rebranding
services.description: Refreshing an existing identity without losing the recognition you have already built, with a staged transition plan across all your materials.

services.title: Packaging & Labels
services.description: Packaging, label and product marking design, production-ready and checked together with our own print department.

process_description: A structured process with clear approval points — you always know which stage you are at.

process.title: Discovery
process.desc: We discuss your business, your audience and your competitors, and agree a clear brief that you sign off before design begins.

process.title: Research & Direction
process.desc: We examine your market and propose design directions with reasoning behind them — not just 'we liked this one'.

process.title: Design
process.desc: We present complete logo proposals in real applications, so you can see how they will actually look in use.

process.title: Revisions
process.desc: You choose a direction and we refine it together. Revision rounds are agreed from the start.

process.title: Delivery
process.desc: You receive every file in every format you will need, along with the identity usage manual.

why_choose_description: We design identities knowing how they will be printed — because we print them too.

features.title: Design & Print Together
features.description: We have our own print department. Everything we design is verified to print correctly, with no surprises in the final result.

features.title: Full File Ownership
features.description: We hand over all original vector files. Your identity is yours, and you can give it to any partner you choose.

features.title: Works at Any Size
features.description: Every logo is checked from app icon through to shop sign, in both colour and single-colour versions.

features.title: Local Presence
features.description: We are at Vas. Pyrrou 30 in Arta. You can drop in, see samples and talk it through in person.

deliverables_description: Every branding project is delivered complete, with no hidden charges for 'extra files'.

faq.question: How much does a logo cost in Arta?
faq.answer: Logo design starts from €250 and includes original design, variants and all vector files. The full corporate identity package starts from €700. The final price depends on the number of applications.

faq.question: How long does identity design take?
faq.answer: A logo is usually completed in 1-2 weeks. A full corporate identity package takes 3-4 weeks, depending on how quickly feedback comes back from your side.

faq.question: How many revision rounds are included?
faq.answer: We agree the revision rounds up front and state them in the quote, so there are no surprises. In practice we keep working until you are happy with the direction you have chosen.

faq.question: Do I get the logo files?
faq.answer: Yes, all of them. We deliver the original vector files (AI, EPS, SVG) along with screen formats. The identity belongs to you and you can pass it to any printer or designer.

faq.question: What is the difference between a logo and a corporate identity?
faq.answer: The logo is your mark. The corporate identity is the whole system around it: colours, fonts, cards, stationery, signage and usage rules. The logo makes you recognisable; the identity keeps you consistent.

faq.question: Can you print the materials as well?
faq.answer: Yes. We have our own print department, so cards, stationery, signage and packaging can be produced by us with a single cost and one quality check.
